user.title: Connect Shelly Pro 3EM
user.description: Enter the IP address of the original Shelly; the device identity and cloud data will be imported automatically.

data.original_shelly_ip: IP address of the original Shelly Pro 3EM
data.original_password: Shelly device password (only if password protection is enabled)

data_description.original_password: The password is used only for the import and is not stored in the integration.

handover.title: Switch off original Shelly and activate bridge
handover.description: The device identity {device} has been imported. **Now the original Shelly Pro 3EM must be powered off or completely disconnected from ALL network connections (Wi-Fi and Ethernet).** The original and the virtual Shelly must not use the same identity in the Shelly Cloud at the same time. After your confirmation, Home Assistant checks that the original IP no longer responds. Afterwards, the virtual Shelly cloud connection is enabled automatically. In the Shelly app it still appears as the same device, not as a second Shelly.

data.original_offline_confirmed: Original Shelly is powered off or fully disconnected from Wi-Fi, Ethernet and Shelly Cloud

cloud_certificate.title: Confirm cloud certificate once
cloud_certificate.description: The Shelly cloud server **{server}** does not provide a certificate chain that Home Assistant can validate. The SHA-256 fingerprint was detected automatically: **`{fingerprint}`**. Verify this fingerprint over an independent connection before confirming it. After confirmation it will be stored permanently. If the certificate changes, the connection will be stopped for safety.

data.certificate_confirmed: I verified the fingerprint and trust this server certificate

isolation_choice.title: Safely disconnect original Shelly from the network
isolation_choice.description: Choose automatic isolation with a protected maintenance access point or power off the original device yourself. No changes are applied to the Shelly until you confirm.

isolation_prepare.title: Configure Shelly access point
isolation_prepare.description: Set a secure password for the access point. The password is used only during setup and is not stored in Home Assistant. Keep it in a safe place.

data.ap_password: Maintenance access point password (8 to 63 characters)

isolation_verify.title: Verify access point and isolate networks
isolation_verify.description: Connect a smartphone to **{ssid}** and check **http://{ap_ip}**. Then return to Home Assistant. Only after your confirmation will the original device's Wi-Fi client and Ethernet be disabled. **Its Shelly Cloud configuration remains unchanged**; the maintenance access point stays active.

data.ap_reachable: I successfully reached the protected access point; isolate the original Shelly now

abort.already_in_progress: A setup for this Shelly is already in progress. Please use the existing dialog.

menu_options.finish_maintenance: Finish maintenance mode after manual shutdown

handover.title: Confirm cloud handover
handover.description: Before the bridge becomes active in Shelly Cloud as {device}, the physical Shelly must be fully powered off or disconnected from all networks. Also check for any alternative internet connections.

data.original_offline_confirmed: Original Shelly fully powered off / disconnected

tls_warning.title: Confirm TLS exception explicitly
tls_warning.description: In Shelly compatibility mode the WSS connection remains encrypted, but the authenticity of the server is **not verified**. An attacker on the network could redirect the connection and read the Shelly cloud key. Prefer a trusted certificate or an independently verified certificate fingerprint whenever possible. Continue only if you consciously accept this risk.

data.tls_risk_accepted: I accept the security risk and want to use compatibility mode.

cloud.title: Shelly Cloud and TLS
cloud.description: These settings are saved directly without selecting the measurement sources again. The original Shelly must remain fully disconnected from all networks for the cloud connection.

data.cloud_tls_fingerprint: SHA-256 fingerprint of the server certificate (fingerprint mode only)

data_description.cloud_tls_fingerprint: The fingerprint is visible as an unverified value in the Cloud server status sensor. Verify it independently before using it.

trust_certificate.title: Confirm cloud certificate
trust_certificate.description: **Server:** {server}. **Detected SHA-256 fingerprint:** `{fingerprint}`. Verify this fingerprint independently. After confirmation it will be stored as trusted permanently; you do not need to type it in.

original_isolation.title: Start maintenance mode for original Shelly
original_isolation.description: The virtual Shelly instance will be fully stopped. Only AFTER THAT may the original Shelly be powered on again. The virtual cloud connection remains blocked until the maintenance is finished.

data.maintenance_confirmed: Stop virtual Shelly now and start maintenance mode

original_isolation_prepare.title: Activate original Shelly and secure access point
original_isolation_prepare.description: If it is still powered off: power on the original Shelly now and reach it at the previously known IP address. The virtual Shelly remains blocked. Set an access point password; it is not stored.

data.ap_password: Password for the Shelly access point (8 to 63 characters)

original_isolation_verify.title: Test maintenance access point
original_isolation_verify.description: Connect a smartphone to **{ssid}** and open **http://{ap_ip}**. After your confirmation, only the Wi-Fi client and Ethernet of the original device will be disabled. Its cloud configuration remains in place. Afterwards, the virtual instance can be enabled again.

data.ap_reachable: Access point tested – isolate original now and enable virtual cloud

finish_maintenance.title: Finish maintenance mode
finish_maintenance.description: The original Shelly must be powered off or fully isolated from the cloud and network before the virtual device identity may go online again.

data.offline_confirmed: Original Shelly is fully isolated or powered off
